branches.head: 1425d078afe4b429cb141491f6cfa1eb545f15ef
unmerged_ddr_commits: 1425d078afe4b429cb141491f6cfa1eb545f15ef LiteDRAM core at 133.33 MHz: the three sys-domain families of the 812bb01 full build (+0.077 to +0.127 ns, the core's worst), all the die's scale (the two channels at its two ends, one register driving loads at both), cut in the generator; no change in the CSR map or the data paths. (1) The CSR bus (interface1_dat_w -> phaseinjector*_storage, 0 levels, 97% route, about 140 loads over 200 rows): a register stage per group of banks (tools/litedram/csr_pipe.py: channel 0's, channel 1's, the rest), each group's read data back through a register, LiteX's registered Wishbone2CSR acking two cycles later (an access 3 -> 5 sys cycles; the host's AXI-Lite and the calibration CPU handshake). (2) The sys reset (FDPE_1 -> dfi_p*_address R, 3,794 loads, 6.8 ns of route): FDPE_1 is the synchronizer's ASYNC_REG flip-flop, which Vivado does not replicate; WLCRG(rst_reg=True) (the test images keep the stock reset) puts a plain register after it (initially 1, max_fanout 256), so the whole sys reset (controllers, the PHYs' wlrst serializer resets from sys_rst, the write-clock MMCMs' resets) releases a cycle later in the same order. (3) The ECC counters (read bitslip -> decoder -> ded_errors_status CE, 11 levels): ecc_ports.py counts from registered flags (e & !clear), LiteDRAMNativePortECC's counters a cycle late; the read data, and so both ports' identical read buses, unchanged; the four ECC CSRs per channel stay. Regenerated (gen_core.py --phy wl --selfcal --fw-id 4461c052): only otpu_litedram.v changes (csr.csv, sdram_init.py, the XDC and the firmware ROM byte for byte); core.json's hashes; sim/verilator/otpu_ldc_ch.v regenerated (gen_ldc.py, the ECC module). Checks: csr_pipe_check.py (migen, LiteX's bridge and bus against the pipelined ones, 3,000 random accesses to every word and unmapped offsets; banks with a 32-bit storage, a 64-bit atomic_write storage, a 40-bit status, a CSR's write / read strobes as the PHYs' delay-line taps, pulse fields): the same read data and storages, every strobe once and in order with its data, 3 -> 5 cycles per access; fails with one wait cycle fewer or without the read-data register. ecc_ports_check.py 600 cycles (compared a cycle later, 0 after a clear): PASS at seeds 1, 2, 3. selfcal_sim.py on the regenerated core, its SoC on the same pipelined bridge and bus (stride 16, --hold-test): 643,724 CSR writes identical to ddrcal's, c0_ready / c1_ready 1 / 1, both channels' results equal ddrcal's, the hold test passes. Co-simulation on omarchy: test_rtl.py -k ldc 5 passed; perf_qwen --wformat fp4 --ddr 1066 --mhz 133.33 --ldc 1,478,549 cycles before (d3d5f0f) and after, the whole profile identical. check_core.sh reproduces the committed core; make lint clean. docs/litedram.md section 12.
